beforeSubmitPrompt.command: cat >/dev/null; p=$BUBU_AGENT_PORT; [ -n "$p" ] || p=47614; curl -s -m 1 -o /dev/null -X POST -H "X-Bubu-Agent: 1" "http://127.0.0.1:$p/v1/agent/cursor/prompt" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo '{"continue":true}'

stop.command: cat >/dev/null; p=$BUBU_AGENT_PORT; [ -n "$p" ] || p=47614; curl -s -m 1 -o /dev/null -X POST -H "X-Bubu-Agent: 1" "http://127.0.0.1:$p/v1/agent/cursor/stop" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo '{}'
